page.overview:
Who is Ruby Oaks?

"Nicknamed "Easy" Oaks for his laid back attitude and his slow, gravelly voice, Ruby Oaks view of life mirrors his approach to racing. He likes to take it easy, gather his thoughts, get folks to let their guard down, and when they least expect it, take the lead."

He was replaced by Carl Clutchen in Cars 3.
